# QXDM

**Author:** QUALCOMM Incorporated<br/>
**Platforms:** BREW

<div className="screenshot">

![QXDM: screenshot 1](./qxdm/img/qxdm.png)

</div>

Qualcomm eXtensible Diagnostic Monitor receives diagnostic messages and phone events, records ISF logs, and allows you to view, filter, and parse the collected data. The program supports diagnostic commands, automation, and plug-in extensions.
